purpose: AI-generated concept mockups for theme inspiration; not outputs from the demo renderer.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create one premium photorealistic e-commerce flat-lay image for a family-reunion graphic tee. Vertical 4:5 composition, whole shirt centered and entirely visible, on a warm pale limestone studio background, no props, no person, no hanger, no collage or inset. Relaxed modern heavyweight washed FOREST GREEN cotton T-shirt, believable construction, ribbed collar, visible fine cotton knit, subtle natural wrinkles and soft window-light shadows. The shirt must look like a real desirable piece of vintage outdoor merchandise, never a flat vector shirt silhouette.
Artwork: a confident professionally art-directed large chest screen print, inspired by illustrated national-park souvenir posters and vintage camp merch. Detailed hand-engraved spreading oak tree framing a tiny lakeside cabin, winding path, mountain ridge, setting sun and wildflowers. Rich drawing with varied line weight, tactile lightly weathered ink, cream, muted ochre and a restrained burnt-orange accent. Strong handsome curved condensed serif headline above the scene, carefully typeset secondary line below. Balanced organic composition, integrated illustration and typography; not a small isolated tree icon in an oval, no generic clipart badge.
Exact headline: "TOGETHER AGAIN". Exact smaller line: "SAME ROOTS. NEW MEMORIES." No other lettering, dates, logos, watermarks, labels, UI or decoration outside the shirt. Textile print should follow the subtle fabric folds realistically. Treat this as a polished independent apparel brand campaign, detailed and tasteful, not a craft template.
